id: title:Gilbert09:recognize cross source non retryable errors in schema discovery

review.posthog_relevance: This change resides in the warehouse ingestion and discovery workflow. It prevents transient, retryable database errors from consuming the entire discovery budget by correctly identifying shared, unresolvable database host errors as non-retryable. This protects the reliability of warehouse connection establishment and prevents unnecessary resource exhaustion during discovery.
review.reason: The observed hunk P1.F1.H2 introduces a shared error set (`Any_Source_Errors`) and a test to verify that shared, cross-source errors are skipped. This is a substantive, bounded correctness improvement: it ensures that a specific class of database errors is not treated as transient, thereby preventing the workflow from wasting discovery budget and spamming error tracking.
